payload.body: ESTATE FOLD AND COMPACT (hv decision 29, hv's word through devbin-vc at 09:22Z). Start nothing new: the Desk grants nothing until devbin-vc's word after the cycle. cc's spike and probe slot runs to its END, then cc folds. Each seat: localfold with no release (archive what is finished, clear what is handled, commit your own board and records by path). Bank work in progress outside main: a worktree's changes go in a commit on its own branch, never on main. Make your RESUME current, and set a one-line focus that says where you resume. Then go quiet: no tool call in flight, no background waiter, nothing half-written. Send vc "FOLDED: <your resume line>". After hv's compact: /in-session, then hold for devbin-vc's word before any run.
